summary: Space Health is a project created with the goal of monitoring and providing assistance. It is a tool that allows both astronauts and the control center to safely know when something goes wrong and what exactly is happening. There may be times when messages cannot get through, but with Space Health, astronauts will always have access to medical assistance. It will provide a way to buy valuable time and potentially save a life when a situation seems hopeless.
details:
This project monitors temperature, vital signs, blood oxygen levels, mental health, and more, using astronauts' spacesuits, regardless of the type of suit they wear. For greater comfort, it will also use smartwatches and smart bracelets, as well as health-tracking app data to provide information to its AI.

The AI will be responsible for supporting astronauts psychologically and assisting them during critical situations, especially when messages take a long time to reach Earth.

Space Health is not just a nurse checking how you feel; it is a doctor that will keep you alive until help arrives.

This project could improve the well-being of astronauts during space missions because it focuses on both their mental and physical health. It helps prevent health problems and encourages astronauts to take care of themselves and each other. This will make space travel more comfortable and safer, especially during long missions.

We used Claude to develop the system. The creativity behind this project comes from the fact that it is not just a system that monitors your health and reports it to the control center. It is a companion that helps you understand how you are feeling, keeps track of your teammates' health, and, if necessary, guides you through the steps needed to save their lives until medical specialists arrive.

We took into consideration the psychological challenges astronauts may experience, as well as the fact that they are not doctors but still need to know how to respond correctly to emergencies inside the spacecraft. They need the knowledge, monitoring, and guidance necessary to protect their lives, even when messages take up to 30 minutes to reach Earth.

When entering the software, we have two sections: one for Crew Members and another one for Admin.

In the Crew Members section, you must enter the name of one of the crew members already registered in the software, for example, Mateo Rivas. The password for this section is 2020.

In the Admin section, you can enter the name of whoever is acting as the administrator and using the software. The password for this section is 2026.

By following these steps, we can log into the software without any problems.
